handoffPurpose: Capture the huge-field ambient effect and zoom-out performance pass.
currentUserGoal: Fix stalls when multiple sprinkler, companion, mutation, touch, and field-life effects happen on an absolutely huge field, while preserving room for more non-manual visual activity later.

workCompleted.summary: Added a short-window ambient visual event budget for huge and pressured fields so stacked helper/touch effects degrade to compact versions instead of drawing every full effect at once.
Compacted sprinkler and companion action visuals under ambient pressure: fewer arc sprites, smaller particle bursts, and tracked board transients for helper pings/scratch marks.
Reduced generic automated touch burst sizes when ambient feedback is compact, including large-field manual-touch budget paths.

Fixed a zoom-out edge case where large common-layer redraws could stamp more than a thousand visible tiles in one layout. Large redraws are now queued without creating thousands of temporary live tile views.

knownIssuesOrDesignQuestions: The trigger-feed UI can still be a low-single-digit hotspot when many feed rows update together. It did not cause frame spikes in this pass.
The live stress checks exercise synthetic stress state, not the user's exact saved field, but they cover larger visible-tile counts than the screenshot.
Adding more idle screen activity should route through the new ambient visual event budget instead of bypassing it.
recommendedNextSteps: Use the new budgeted visual path for the next feature pass: sprinklers, companions, weather, and automation can add more idle visuals by reserving compact ambient events first.
If the next pass adds persistent sprinkler/companion animations, keep them pooled or emitter-based rather than creating many independent Phaser objects.
Manually play the user's real huge save for feel, especially zooming out fully while trigger feed, sprinkler, companions, and field-life visuals are active.
doNotRevert: Do not restore full sprinkler/companion effect payloads for every ambient helper action on huge fields; that is the stall source this pass reduces.
Do not let large common-layer redraws create live tile views for every visible tile. That briefly pushed displayObjects above 7000 during an intermediate fix.
Keep large redraws queued after common-layer preview redraws so zoom-out redraw work is spread across frames.
